summary: Two hikers lost in the woods east of Vail ski area; the first called 911 about 7 p.m. Monday after falling off a trail and spending hours trying to hike out. Vail Mountain Rescue Group and Vail Ski Patrol located and brought him to safety. He failed to tell rescuers he had been with a companion; at 9:30 a.m. Tuesday he reported Samuel Failla, 24, of New Jersey, missing. Searchers returned to the same area and found Failla's body.
location: woods east of Vail ski area
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group; Vail Ski Patrol; Eagle County Sheriff's Office
notes: Date approximate: incident reported as a Monday/Tuesday pair; SnowBrains item last updated ~2018-02-07, placing rescue Mon 2018-02-05 and body recovery Tue 2018-02-06. Mixed outcome: one companion rescued alive, Samuel Failla found deceased; Eagle County coroner investigating cause of death.
